label someone as lazy: You should not label someone as lazy just because they need more time to finish their homework.
你不該只因為某人需要更多時間完成作業，就給他貼上懶惰的標籤。
label a product: Food companies must clearly label a product with its ingredients so that shoppers with special diets can choose safely.
食品公司必須清楚標示產品的成分，讓有特殊飲食需求的顧客能安心選購。
be labeled a traitor: In wartime, anyone who disagreed with the government could be labeled a traitor and sent to prison.
在戰時，任何不同意政府的人都可能被扣上叛徒的帽子並被關進監獄。
label the boxes: Before the movers arrive, please label the boxes with the names of the rooms they belong to.
搬家工人到之前，請在箱子上貼標籤，寫上它們所屬房間的名稱。
labor under the illusion: Many teenagers labor under the illusion that they can get rich quickly by becoming famous online.
許多青少年誤以為只要在網路上成名就能快速致富。
labor over a report: My father had to labor over a report all weekend because his boss wanted it on Monday morning.
我爸爸整個週末都得埋頭寫報告，因為他老闆星期一早上就要。
labor the point: We already understand why safety matters, so there is no need to labor the point any longer.
我們已經明白安全為什麼重要了，所以沒有必要再反覆說明這一點。
labor in the fields: In the past, many children had to labor in the fields with their parents instead of going to school.
過去，許多孩子必須和父母一起在田裡勞動，而不能去上學。
lace up one's shoes: Before the race began, every runner bent down to lace up their shoes tightly so they would not trip.
比賽開始前，每位跑者都彎下身把鞋帶綁緊，以免絆倒。
lace the drink with poison: In the mystery novel, the butler secretly tried to lace the drink with poison during the dinner party.
在那本推理小說中，管家在晚宴時偷偷想在飲料裡下毒。
laced with humor: Although the speech was about a serious topic, it was laced with humor that kept the audience laughing.
雖然那場演講的主題很嚴肅，但內容帶著幽默，讓觀眾笑聲不斷。
lace one's fingers: When he feels nervous before a speech, my teacher likes to lace his fingers together and take a deep breath.
演講前感到緊張時，我的老師喜歡十指交扣並深呼吸。
lag behind competitors: If the company does not invest in new ideas, it will soon lag behind competitors in the global market.
如果公司不投資新點子，很快就會在全球市場上落後對手。
lag in technology: Some rural schools still lag in technology, so their students seldom get to use computers in class.
有些鄉下學校的科技仍然落後，所以學生很少有機會在課堂上使用電腦。
time lag: There is usually a time lag of a few seconds between seeing the lightning and hearing the thunder.
看到閃電和聽到雷聲之間，通常會有幾秒的時間差。
land a job: After sending out more than fifty applications, my cousin finally managed to land a job at a bank.
寄出五十多份履歷後，我表哥終於得到一份在銀行的工作。
land a contract: After months of hard work, our small company was able to land a contract with a major airline.
經過數個月的努力，我們的小公司拿下了與一家大型航空公司的合約。
land in trouble: If you keep copying your classmates' homework, you will land in trouble with the teacher sooner or later.
如果你一直抄同學的作業，遲早會惹上老師那邊的麻煩。
the plane landed: Everyone on board clapped and cheered when the plane landed safely after flying through the storm.
飛機穿越暴風雨後安全降落時，機上的每個人都拍手歡呼。
land a punch: The young boxer was fast enough to land a punch on his opponent's chin in the first round.
那位年輕拳擊手速度夠快，在第一回合就打中對手下巴一拳。
land on one's feet: Even after losing his job, Tom always seems to land on his feet and find something better.
即使丟了工作，湯姆似乎總能化險為夷，找到更好的出路。
launch a product: The phone company plans to launch a product next month that can translate speech into ten languages.
那家手機公司計劃下個月推出一款能把語音翻譯成十種語言的產品。
launch an attack: Late at night, the enemy decided to launch an attack on the city while most people were sleeping.
深夜時，敵軍趁大多數人熟睡時決定對這座城市發動攻擊。
launch a campaign: The school will launch a campaign on social media to encourage students to bring their own water bottles.
學校將在社群媒體上發起一項活動，鼓勵學生自備水壺。
launch a career: Winning the singing contest helped her launch a career in music when she was only seventeen.
贏得歌唱比賽幫助她在年僅十七歲時就開啟了音樂職涯。
launch a rocket: Scientists waited for clear weather before they could launch a rocket carrying a new satellite into space.
科學家們等到天氣晴朗，才發射一枚載著新衛星進入太空的火箭。
launch an investigation: After money went missing from the office, the police decided to launch an investigation into the matter.
辦公室的錢不見之後，警方決定對此事展開調查。
lay the foundation: Reading widely in junior high school can lay the foundation for good writing skills in the future.
國中時廣泛閱讀能為將來良好的寫作能力打基礎。
lay the blame on: Instead of admitting his mistake, he tried to lay the blame on his younger brother.
他不但不承認自己的錯，還試圖把責任歸咎於他弟弟。
lay off workers: Because sales dropped sharply this year, the factory had to lay off workers for the first time in history.
由於今年銷售量大幅下滑，工廠有史以來第一次不得不裁員。
lay down the rules: On the first day of class, the new teacher will lay down the rules about phones and homework.
開學第一天，新老師會訂下關於手機和作業的規矩。
lay out a plan: At the meeting, the manager will lay out a plan to cut costs without firing anyone.
會議上，經理將擬定一項在不裁掉任何人的情況下削減成本的計畫。
lay eggs: Every summer, sea turtles return to this quiet beach to lay eggs in the warm sand.
每年夏天，海龜都會回到這片寧靜的海灘，在溫暖的沙中下蛋。
lay the table: While Mom was cooking dinner, she asked me to lay the table with plates, forks, and napkins.
媽媽在煮晚餐時，叫我擺餐桌，放上盤子、叉子和餐巾。
